_readme: Deliberate exceptions to scripts/design-check.mjs. Every entry needs a rule, a file and a real reason; an entry that stops matching is reported so the list cannot rot. Brief-locked deviations are listed by id in docs/DESIGN-GUIDELINES.md section 14.

entries.reason: The one rgba() string builder canvas code uses; its channels are read from the eight tokens at runtime (CLAUDE.md, Theme).
D5/D9: the procedural lure artwork (brief: no photography). It is art, not an icon, and every layer is aria-hidden.
D9: the one decorative swell edge where the categories sheet meets the hero water (brief-supplied).
